messages:
maria_sales: ACME POC just finished. They asked a bunch on BYO-KMS / HSM: key custody, rotation windows, and how that changes pricing. Can ops/security help draft a short answer we can put in the SOW? cc: @dylan_solutions @lee_security

 dylan_solutions: Short version — we support customer-managed keys via our BYO-KMS connector (CloudKMS, CloudHSM, AWS KMS). For HSM-backed keys we can either import HSM-wrapped keys or integrate with their KMS over our private connector. Note: cross-region key replication is not automatic — requires explicit replication plan.

 ashley_cloudops: Ops note: HSM-backed Dedicated is currently available in us-east1 and us-west2 only. If ACME needs multi-region active-active keys, we'll need a secondary HSM cluster and network peering. Lead time for HSM cluster provisioning + validation is ~4 weeks.

 lee_security: Compliance constraints: we require a key policy that explicitly prevents Redwood from exporting plaintext key material. Rotation: default recommendation is 90 days; we can allow 30-day rotation for customers with documented justification (e.g., PCI). Also need to confirm whether the customer expects us to perform rotation or their KMS.

 maria_sales: They asked for a one-paragraph answer they can paste into their security questionnaire. Can someone draft that?

 dylan_solutions: Here are two snippets — one for the questionnaire and one sample connector config they can include:

 Questionnaire snippet:
 "Redwood supports customer-managed encryption keys (CMKs) via our BYO-KMS connector. Customers retain control of key material; Redwood never exports plaintext keys. We support HSM-backed keys and automated rotation workflows when integrated with the customer's supported KMS. For HSM-backed Dedicated deployments, key custody remains with the customer-managed KMS/HSM and Redwood only receives wrapped keys or KMS request tokens."

 Sample connector config (example):
 ```
 connector: 
   type: gcp-kms
   project: acme-prod
   keyRing: redwood-poc
   cryptoKey: acme-rewrap-key
   serviceAccount: redwood-kms-connector@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
   permissions: ["cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToEncrypt","cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt"]
 ```

 lee_security: Add to that: we need the CMK ARN (or resource name), the key policy, and the declared rotation cadence in the SOW. Also specify algorithm (AES-256 vs RSA/EC) and whether key is used for signing or encryption — some compliance boxes differ.

 ashley_cloudops: Pricing/ops: HSM add-on is a separate SKU — roughly +$12k/mo per HSM cluster (incl. monitoring and backup). Dedicated reserved capacity still applies. For short POCs we can offer a one-time HSM seat waiver for 30 days (approve on a case-by-case). I'll flag finance for a formal quote.

 maria_sales: Perfect. I'll assemble a short SOW paragraph + the connector example and send to ACME. One open ask — can rotation be automated from Redwood side if they give us the service account?

 dylan_solutions: Yes — if they use a supported KMS and grant our connector the needed permissions we can automate rewrap/rotation jobs. Requires connector v1.2+ and service account with kms.* permissions. We'll log rotations and surface them in Console.

 sec-bot: ticket created: SEC-2374 POC BYO-KMS review :white_check_mark:

 maria_sales: Great, thanks everyone — I'll share with ACME now and update this thread after their reply :thumbsup:
